Winter 2025 Newsletter

The archive

Earlier updates

Everything before the story above, newest first. Each card opens the full write-up, most of them with a photo gallery from the day.

IGVC

2023 IGVC Competition

June 5, 2023

Our first trip to the Intelligent Ground Vehicle Competition in Rochester, Michigan. The robot took a design award and the team came home with Rookie of the Year, despite a split gearbox casing and a rough time on the course.

Read the write-up
Pumpkin Chunkin

2022 Trebuchet

September 22, 2022

The old trebuchet was coming apart, so the team rebuilt the whole thing out of 4x4s with a new loading and firing mechanism — then won the competition with 966 points.

Read the write-up
NRC

2020 Competition Cancellation and Recap of Year

May 11, 2020

A full-body spinning combat robot and a self-driving Traxxas running ROS on a Jetson Nano, both headed for the National Robotics Challenge — until Covid-19 halted the season mid-spring.

Read the recap
Outreach

2019 FLL Tournament Volunteering

December 7, 2019

Members refereed the robot game and judged robot design at the regional FIRST LEGO League qualifier in Rapid City — a record 20 teams of 9 to 14 year olds.

Read the write-up
Super Robo Time

Super Robo Time 2019

October 5, 2019

Our annual kick-off with UAS and the 3D Print Club: a lab scavenger hunt, then a few weeks of teams building battlebots out of the same box of parts and fighting it out in the arena.

Read the write-up
Pumpkin Chunkin

2019 Pumpkin Chunkin Competition

September 11, 2019

Efficiency work on the trebuchet got last year's distances out of roughly 30% less counterweight. A cold, rainy day and heavier pumpkins than we had practised with left us in 5th.

Read the write-up
ASME

2019 ASME Student Design Competition

April 6, 2019

B.A.M. — the Ball Acquisition Machine — at the Lansing E-Fest for the Pick-and-Place Race. It won its first elimination round, then stopped dead after a collision in the second.

Read the write-up
Pumpkin Chunkin

2018 Pumpkin Chunkin and Great Downtown Pumpkin Festival

April 11, 2018

A booth at Main Street Square and a trebuchet at Memorial Park. Trailing going into the final throw, the team borrowed weights from a rival, threw farther than ever before, and took the trophy.

Read the write-up
ASME

2018 ASME Student Design Competition

March 6, 2018

Robot soccer in Pomona, California, with three bots in a 50 cm cube: one shooter and two defenders with solenoid kickers. A solid mid-table finish against roughly 32 teams in our first year at the competition.

Read the write-up
IEEE

2016 IEEE Robotics Competition

April 1, 2016

11th out of 29 teams at the IEEE Robotics competition, built together with the UAS team and the 3D Printing Club. The camera never quite came together in time.
